description: iSpot TV conversion GIFs on the documented production and staging /v2/{site}.gif routes. Checks general, retail and automotive fields, custom-data limits and optional forwarding syntax. Omitted app and type retain web and visit defaults. New source-scoped checks are advisory; account mappings and attribution remain external.

params.name: tracking_code
params.description: It is the Site ID on the TV conversion pixel. iSpot documents it as TC-XXXX-X.
params.fix_hint: Put the Site ID from iSpot in the path so it reads /v2/TC-{account}-{site}.gif.

params.name: type
params.description: The conversion guide defaults an omitted type to visit. Supplied event names have a 32-character limit and use underscores in place of whitespace. Event names are configured, not a closed enum.

params.name: app
params.description: The conversion guide defaults an omitted app to web. Use app only for a dedicated mobile app.

params.name: cid
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional cid to 128 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: campaignid
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional campaignid to 64 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: channel
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional channel to 64 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: customdata
params.description: The conversion guide limits customdata to 256 characters and up to five comma-separated dashboard values. Structured legacy server custom data remains opaque; high-cardinality correctness needs surrounding context.

params.name: customertype
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional customertype to 32 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: refid
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional refid to 128 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: uid
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional uid to 128 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: orderid
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional orderid to 64 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: sku
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional sku to 256 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: make
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional make to 32 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: model
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional model to 64 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: tier
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional tier to 32 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: trim
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional trim to 64 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open.

params.name: year
params.description: The conversion guide limits optional year to 16 characters. Values are configured by the integration and remain open. The source declares a string, so four-digit numeric years are not imposed.

params.name: amount
params.description: The retail table declares decimal(7,2). The advisory accepts signed values with up to five significant integer digits and two fractional digits, preserving zero and leading zero padding.

params.name: ip
params.description: An optional original-client IP override. Current iSpot matching guidance also allows IPv6 with an identity partner, so this syntax check accepts both IP families. Omission does not imply missing forwarding.

params.name: datetime
params.description: The server guide describes the original client visit time in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. This advisory checks calendar validity at second resolution. Omission retains immediate browser and header-based integrations; no event-age window is invented.

params.name: method
params.description: The documented conversion image and server-side endpoint use GET.

params.name: headers.x-forwarded-for
params.description: The server guide permits a forwarded chain with the original client address first. Validate supplied IP-chain syntax without requiring the header on browser or query-IP requests. Address provenance is external.
